_readme: Regenerate the v10 recovery samples for the public data release. Same commands as kaggle/plans/v10.json (same model, words, parts and seeds), but the output goes to /kaggle/working so Kaggle keeps it (fetch with --all). No training and no evaluation. The original run printed its statistics (games, wins, events, samples); matching them shows the regenerated data equal the data v10 trained on.
